buttons.notes: Official G300s spec lists Standard+Special buttons as Left/Middle/Right/Forward/Back/DPI+/DPI-/DPI Shift/Profile toggle (9 total, matching this file's count); exact left-to-right physical order of the DPI+/DPI-/DPI Shift trio (G6/G7/G8) is unconfirmed.

save.reason: G300 mode-switch/profile layout needs a dedicated legacy writer

notes: G300 uses a mode/profile switch and a mirrored ambidextrous shell; the mapping is kept separate from the standard six-button family. Shares a USB product ID with G300s; the revisions were not assigned distinct IDs.

G6-G9 relabeled 2026-09-17 from positional names ('Top left/middle/right', 'Mode switch') to Logitech's own functional terms (DPI plus/minus/Shift, Profile toggle), per the G300s spec page (same shared PID, no G300-specific spec page with a button breakdown exists). The previously-cited lgs-guide.pdf was checked directly and confirmed to be a generic multi-device LGS software manual with no G300-specific button diagram -- kept in sources for context, not as evidence for this specific layout.
